question: In each league, considering all seasons, which single team has the fewest total match wins based on comparing home and away goals, including teams with zero wins, ensuring that if multiple teams tie for the fewest wins, only one team is returned for each league?
sql:
WITH wins AS (
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        l.name AS league_name,
        t.team_api_id,
        t.team_long_name,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal AND m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id THEN 1
            WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal AND m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_win
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON (m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id OR m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id)
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        league_name,
        team_api_id,
        team_long_name,
        SUM(is_win) AS total_wins
    FROM wins
    GROUP BY league_id, league_name, team_api_id, team_long_name
),
min_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        league_name,
        MIN(total_wins) AS min_wins
    FROM team_wins
    GROUP BY league_id, league_name
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        tw.league_id,
        tw.league_name,
        tw.team_api_id,
        tw.team_long_name,
        tw.total_wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tw.league_id ORDER BY tw.team_long_name) AS rn
    FROM team_wins tw
    JOIN min_wins mw ON tw.league_id = mw.league_id AND tw.total_wins = mw.min_wins
)
SELECT 
    league_name,
    team_long_name,
    total_wins
FROM ranked_teams
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY league_name
